vocabulary.meaning_en: having a low temperature

vocabulary.meaning_en: not wet

vocabulary.meaning_en: a position or area

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bowl in the kitchen with water taps, for washing

fine_lines.title: in / inside / under / on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: in و inside تعني «داخل» شيء (inside تؤكد أنه داخله تماماً). under تعني «تحت». on تعني «على» سطح الشيء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "In" and "inside" mean within something ("inside" is a little stronger). "Under" means below. "On" means on top of a surface.

examples.sentence: The milk is in the refrigerator.
The eggs are inside the box.
The bag is under the sink.
The list is on the counter.

fine_lines.title: flour vs flower
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان تُنطقان بنفس الطريقة لكن المعنى مختلف: flour طحين للخبز والكيك، flower زهرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They sound the same but have different meanings: flour is a powder for baking; a flower is a plant with colorful petals.

examples.sentence: We need flour to make pancakes.
She gave her teacher a flower.

fine_lines.title: I will vs I'm going to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم I'll عندما نقرر الآن في لحظة الكلام أو نعرض المساعدة (I'll answer the door). ونستخدم going to لخطة مقررة مسبقاً (What are you going to make?).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "I'll" for a decision or offer made right now (I'll answer the door). Use "going to" for a plan you already have (What are you going to make?).

examples.sentence: The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow.

expressions.phrase: Put in a cold, dry place.
expressions.meaning_en: A storage instruction on food packets.
expressions.example: The box says: "Put in a cold, dry place."
Don't worry. I have a plan.

expressions.phrase: What are you going to make?
expressions.example: What are you going to make for lunch?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking what food someone is preparing.
expressions.example: It smells good! What are you cooking?

expressions.meaning_en: The food has a nice flavor.
You found a way to succeed.
expressions.example: The car is running again. You made it work!

expressions.meaning_en: An offer to open the door for a visitor.
expressions.example: Someone is knocking. I'll answer the door.

expressions.meaning_en: I will complete the work here.
expressions.example: You go and rest. I'll finish here.

expressions.phrase: When something goes wrong, just change the plan!
expressions.meaning_ar: عندما يحدث خطأ، فقط غيّر الخطة!
expressions.meaning_en: Be flexible when there are problems.
expressions.example: The park was closed, so we changed the plan.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place: in, inside, under, on
grammar.explanation_ar: حروف الجر المكانية تقول أين يوجد الشيء. في الدرس: The flour is inside the refrigerator. The eggs are inside the cabinet under the sink. نسأل بـ Where is/are...? ونجيب بـ It is / They are + حرف الجر + المكان.
grammar.explanation_en: Prepositions of place tell where something is. In the lesson: The flour is inside the refrigerator. The eggs are inside the cabinet under the sink. Ask "Where is/are...?" and answer "It is / They are + preposition + place".
examples: Where is the flour? It's in the refrigerator.
Where are the eggs? They're inside the cabinet.
The cabinet is under the sink.
The list is on the floor.

grammar.title: I'll for offers and quick decisions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم I will (I'll) + الفعل عندما نعرض المساعدة أو نقرر شيئاً في لحظة الكلام: I'll answer the door. I'll finish here. You clean the living room; I will make dinner.
grammar.explanation_en: Use I will (I'll) + base verb to offer help or make a decision at the moment of speaking: I'll answer the door. I'll finish here.
examples: You clean the living room. I will make dinner.

grammar.title: Simple past in the story
grammar.explanation_ar: تحكي آنا ما حدث بالماضي البسيط: الأفعال المنتظمة تأخذ ed: invited, shopped (نضاعف p). وبعض الأفعال شاذة: put → put، make → made.
grammar.explanation_en: Anna tells the story in the simple past. Regular verbs add -ed: invited, shopped (double the p). Some verbs are irregular: put → put, make → made.
examples: We invited friends to a dinner party.
I shopped with the wrong list.
I put the flour inside the refrigerator.

questions.question: Anna put the eggs inside the cabinet ___ the sink.
questions.explanation_ar: الخزانة تحت الحوض: under the sink.
questions.explanation_en: The cabinet is below the sink: under the sink.

questions.explanation_ar: flour طحين أبيض نصنع منه الخبز والكيك.
questions.explanation_en: Flour is a white powder used for bread and cakes.

questions.question: The doorbell rings. What do you say?

questions.explanation_ar: نعرض المساعدة بقرار لحظي باستخدام I'll.
questions.explanation_en: Use "I'll" for a quick decision or offer.

questions.explanation_en: Cold, dry place = a cool place that is not wet.
